description.value:
Saving throws +1. Being hit without temporary HP grants 5 temporary HP lasting 2 turns, with a 3-turn cooldown. While you have temporary HP, reduce incoming damage by 1 per hit.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching preservation Path required.
